title: Cyber Diamond Tools
description: The Cyber Diamond Tools is a competitive 16x16 pack (PvP/Survival) that brings a cyberpunk/synthwave aesthetic.
body: Cyber Diamond Tools is a competitive 16x16 texture pack (PvP/Survival) designed for those who want to transform the classic look of Minecraft. It replaces the default design of diamond tools with a striking and aggressive cyberpunk/synthwave aesthetic.
